entrypoints.summary: A peer-provided tipset-message response supplies CompactedMessages BlsIncludes and SecpkIncludes uint64 indexes during synchronization; the writeup also describes a Hello-protocol path that requests a newer peer tipset.

affected_components.file: Lotus/Venus synchronization client validation and compacted-message processing
affected_components.role: The validator narrows peer indexes before bounds comparison; later paths dereference the original indexes.

code_slices.fixed: The stated repair compares the uint64 index with a slice length cast to an unsigned type.
code_slices.surrounding_context: checkMsgMeta and validatedResponse.toFullTipSets subsequently index message slices using the received uint64 values.
code_slices.vulnerable: validateCompressedIndices tests int(mi) >= len(msgs.Bls); large uint64 values convert to negative int values and pass.

impacts.concept: remote Filecoin node denial of service

relation_candidates.rationale: A peer can select an index above the signed-int maximum; conversion to int makes it negative and it passes the one-sided comparison.
The received uint64 index that passed validation is used by checkMsgMeta and full-tipset decompression to index message slices.

relation_candidates.dst: remote Filecoin node denial of service
relation_candidates.rationale: The documented consequence of the out-of-range slice operation is an index-out-of-range panic that remotely crashes a node.
Comparing the received uint64 index against an unsigned representation of slice length prevents the signed conversion that permits the bypass.

impact.affected_asset: Availability of Filecoin Lotus and Venus nodes.
impact.attacker_capability: Cause a receiving Lotus or Venus node to process an oversized compacted-message index that passes the signed-domain validation and reaches a slice dereference.
impact.security_effect: Remote denial of service through a Go index-out-of-range panic.

causal_trace.summary: A remote peer controls uint64 message-index values in CompactedMessages.BlsIncludes and, analogously, SecpkIncludes.

validateCompressedIndices converts each received uint64 index to int before comparing it with the corresponding message-slice length. A value above the signed-int maximum becomes negative and passes the one-sided signed comparison.
The original unchecked uint64 index is subsequently dereferenced as allbmsgs[m] or allsmsgs[m] in checkMsgMeta, and as msgs.Bls[mi] or msgs.Secpk[mi] while forming full tipsets.
The invalid slice index produces an index-out-of-range panic, allowing remote node crash and denial of service.

failure.operation: Go slice indexing with a peer-controlled index after bypassed validation

primary_invariant.statement: Every peer-supplied compacted-message index must be representable in the validation domain and satisfy 0 <= index < length of its target message slice before that index is dereferenced.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The validator narrows a uint64 index to int for a one-sided comparison, so large unsigned values can convert to negative signed values and evade the upper-bound check while the original uint64 is later used for slice indexing.

quality.review_notes: The research post contains the vulnerable validation and two dereference paths, and the Venus PR independently documents the MaxUint64-to--1 bypass rationale and a merged fix. No patch diff, regression test, standalone network replay, or recorded panic trace is available in this bundle. The Lotus PR page is retained only as a locator because its visible title/excerpt does not establish the validation-change semantics.

remediation.invariant_restored: The target slice length is converted to an unsigned type and compared with the uint64 received index, so indexes outside the slice domain cannot pass validation because of signed conversion.
mitigation_classes: preserve unsigned numeric domain for bounds checks
reject indexes at or above target slice length before dereference

state_context.attacker_state_setup: A peer supplies a tipset-message response with BlsIncludes or SecpkIncludes containing an index greater than the signed-int maximum.
data_structure_invariants: BlsIncludes and SecpkIncludes map block positions to entries in their respective message slices.
The number of BlsIncludes entries is expected to match the number of blocks.
Every included message index must be within the associated message slice's valid index domain.

numeric_domains.attacker_constraints: The peer controls the received index; an index above the signed-int maximum is sufficient to exploit the signed conversion check.
numeric_domains.name: message index mi

numeric_domains.attacker_constraints: The converted value is compared only against the upper bound, allowing a negative converted result to pass.
numeric_domains.name: validation conversion int(mi)
sentinel_values: -1 after conversion from math.MaxUint64, as documented for the Venus PR

state_context.state_machine: Peer synchronization receives tipset headers and compacted messages, validates message indexes, then checks metadata or decompresses messages into full tipsets.

target.component: peer tipset-message synchronization and compacted-message decompression
